name: PACountyCode
description: Pennsylvania County Code (16 P.S.) key sections

controllerSections.title: Bond
controllerSections.summary: Controller must give bond as fixed by court

controllerSections.title: Deputy and Clerks
controllerSections.summary: May appoint deputy and necessary clerks

controllerSections.title: Oath of Deputy
controllerSections.summary: Deputy must take oath of office

controllerSections.title: General Powers and Duties
controllerSections.summary: General fiscal officer, auditor of all accounts

controllerSections.title: Pre-audit of Claims
controllerSections.summary: Examine and audit all claims BEFORE payment

controllerSections.title: Annual Audits
controllerSections.summary: Audit accounts of all county officers annually

controllerSections.title: Special Audits
controllerSections.summary: May audit any officer at any time

controllerSections.title: Access to Records
controllerSections.summary: Full access to all records, papers, accounts

controllerSections.title: Report of Audits
controllerSections.summary: File report of each audit with court

controllerSections.title: Budget Preparation
controllerSections.summary: Assist in preparation of county budget

powers: Access to all records and documents
Report findings to court and council
auditAuthority.independence: Controller operates independently of County Executive and reports to voters
